title: Assistant manager - Warehouse
description:
**About BECO**
BECO is a revolutionary home care brand dedicated to sustainability and eco-friendliness. Our plant-based, bamboo-based products are highly effective and 100% chemical-free, offering environmentally conscious solutions without compromising on quality. As a direct-to-consumer (D2C) brand, we are on a mission to make the world a better place, one home at a time.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage day-to-day warehouse operations, including inbound, outbound, inventory and dispatch.
* Ensure accurate stock management, cycle counts and inventory reconciliation.
* Handle order processing, picking, packing and timely dispatch.
* Monitor warehouse productivity, space utilisation and operational efficiency.
* Manage warehouse staff, manpower planning and task allocation.
* Ensure proper implementation of WMS/ERP and warehouse processes.
* Coordinate with Supply Chain, Logistics and other internal teams.
* Maintain warehouse safety, housekeeping and compliance standards.
* Track operational KPIs and prepare regular MIS reports.

**Candidate Requirements**

* 5–8 years of experience in warehouse operations.
* Prior experience in D2C, FMCG or product-based companies preferred.
* Hands-on experience with WMS/ERP and inventory management.
* Strong understanding of inbound, outbound, dispatch and stock reconciliation.
* Experience in team handling and warehouse process management.
* Good analytical, coordination and problem-solving skills.

title: Sr. Manager/Manager - Supply Chain Management
description:
**Sr. Manager/Manager - SCM**
**Position Summary**
Magellan Aerospace (Tumkur) Private Limited has an exciting opportunity for a Sr. Manager. This position is responsible for leading the end-to-end supply chain functions by ensuring timely availability of materials and components, effective supplier management, inventory optimization, cost efficiency, risk mitigation, and compliance with applicable aerospace quality and customer requirements while driving continuous improvement and supply chain resilience.
  
  
**Essential Responsibilities**

* Responsible for evaluating, assessing and selecting vendors based on capabilities, performance and consistent quality. Maintains rapport and good working relationships with vendors; keeps accurate vendor records.
* Evaluates inventory reorder levels and quantity price breaks to determine most economical purchasing of inventory and supplies in relationship to company’s cost of capital. Prepares monthly reports and reviews forecast of purchasing commitments with Finance. Responsible for buying capital goods.
* Manage & expedite purchase orders as necessary and ensures delivery of purchased items for uninterrupted manufacturing flow.
* Responsible for meeting inventory turnover ratio targets
* Liaison with production department to keep optimum Inventory.
* Liaison with Finance department for timely payment of bills
* Responsible for checking skill matrices before allocating tasks to emp.
* Developing store strategies.
* Oversee all finished goods labelling, packing and all applicable packing procedures.
* Creating and monitoring of effective inventory system to minimize the inventory.
* Guiding, Leading and monitoring of the Stores, Tool crib and packing department activities on time-to-time basis to middle management personnel.
* To be aware of ISO 14001 – 2015 standards
* To be aware of the aspect & impact pertaining to EMS in the particular function.
* Recommend changes in the EMS to top management

**Position Requirements**
Ideally, the jobholder should possess the following Education Qualifications, Skills and experience.
  
  
**Education Qualification:**
Degree in Mechanical Engineering preferred
  
  
**Indicative Years of Experience Required:**
**12-15 Years In Purchase (Preferred In Aerospace Industry)**
**Skills Set Required:**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively interact with team members and stakeholders.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure and within tight timelines to meet project deadlines.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and MS Project for project documentation and tracking.
* Strong strategic planning and problem-solving skills to manage project requirements.
* Strong follow-through and comprehensive project management skills to ensure successful project execution.
* Good understanding of the complete New Product Development (NPD) project cycle.
* Proficiency in identifying risks affecting supply and delivery and developing effective mitigation strategies

title: Architect - Server and Virtualization
description:
Tata Semiconductor Assembly & Test (TSAT) is a greenfield venture of the Tata Group with expertise in manufacturing in IC & SMT Packages.
  
  
Tata Electronics (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) is building India’s first AI-enabled state-of-the-art Semiconductor Packaging facility . This facility will produce chips for applications such as power management IC, display drivers, microcontrollers (MCU) and high-performance computing logic, addressing the growing demand in markets such as automotive, computing and data storage, wireless communications and artificial intelligence.
  
  
TSAT is a subsidiary of the Tata group. The Tata Group operates in more than 100 countries across six continents, with the mission 'To improve the quality of life of the communities we serve globally, through long term stakeholder value creation based on leadership with Trust.’
  
  
**Job Description**
A Server Lead will be primarily responsible for:
  
  

* New server & Storage deployments
* Lead Enterprise Computing operations
* Meet the operations support with the expansion in Infrastructure
* Ensure server related requirements and incidents are addressed on time.

**Key Responsibilities**

* New Server deployment (20%)



* Understand the IT infra requirement and work on preparing plan for deployment. Based on the Business requirements, prepare BoQ in early stages to help in placing the order.
* To be a part of technical evaluation of solution and technologies.
* Coordinate with the OEM/Partner for planning and deployment of solutions on time
* Enterprise Computing Operations Management (40%)
* Manage the support operations and ensure the reported issues are addressed on time
* Handle escalations and manage to resolve the escalated incidents.
* Ensure the availability of servers & Storage and coordinate with required teams to fix any issues.
* Manage shift Roster for the team to ensure support coverage
* Ensure devices availability is monitored, and any health alerts are addressed immediately
* Monitor and manage the Data Centre operations
* Maintain a checklist for routine health check of the Enterprise Compute Infra
* Ensure scheduled reports are monitored and necessary actions are taken against them.
* Compliance & Security (10%)
* Ensure the server Infra and endpoints are complaint with the ES security controls
* Ensure periodic Audits and Vulnerability assessment is performed on the Network devices and ensure the findings are remediated
* Ensure the device inventory is updated and a monthly compliance checklist is published
* Visit Data Centre to ensure all Data Centre controls are working and work with internal team for quarterly testing of the controls
* Incident & Change Management (10%)
* Need to front end the critical incidents, evaluate the RCA and follow up for the preventive action closures
* Need to ensure change controls are followed and unauthorised changes are prevented
* Ensure all Changes are documented in the ITSM tool, Review the change plan impact
* Ensure the agreed SLA is met for Enterprise Computing operations
* Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery (10%)
* Be a part of DR/BCP planning for Enterprise computing devices and plan for meeting the RPO /RTO defined
* Ensure business continuity in case devices failures (Ensure devices backup is available, required standby devices are available and support team is aligned for replacement)
* Documentation (10%)
* Review and version-control critical documents
* Incorporate any server infra changes into documentation
* Ensure accessibility for the team when required.

**Qualification & Work Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or an equivalent qualification
* Any Profession certifications in Servers, Virtualisation platform, storage will be an added advantage
* 10–12 years of experience with prior lead experience and Data Centre operations
* Experience managing large IT infrastructure; manufacturing domain exposure is an advantage

**Key Interaction Requirements**

* With DRI from all internal units - to understand and fulfil IT related business requests, troubleshoot any issues they report
* With Other Internal Digital Teams to understand and fulfil IT related business requests & collaborate with them to troubleshoot
* With Internal Teams to handle operations management
* With external OEM/Vendors to troubleshoot, support, Service level reviews & escalations.

title: Associate Director, Managed Review AP
description:
**What is special about Lighthouse?**
Lighthouse is built on a foundation of unique, compassionate, highly driven individuals. We elevate the strengths and talents of those around us while leveraging opportunities for growth. We offer the experience of solving complex problems while continuing to grow multiple facets of your career. Lighthouse is where innovation meets support and where collaboration is the key ingredient to success. We grow together and are stronger together.
  
  
**What’s unique about this role?**
The Lighthouse Associate Director, Managed Review AP is responsible for onsite leadership of Lighthouse’s Managed Review function in India and driving collaboration with the broader Lighthouse Managed Review leadership team. Responsibilities include providing leadership and guidance to Review Managers in delivery of Lighthouse Managed Review in India. This role is accountable for performance and results delivered by Lighthouse India Managed Review. The Associate Director will support the sales team, engage in client discussions, and collaborate with Lighthouse teams to provide optimized client solutions.
  
  
This is a dynamic leadership role advancing Lighthouse’s tech-forward approach enabling our clients to drastically reduce spending on linear document review. You will gain exposure to Lighthouse’s market-disruptive technologies, collaborate with internal stakeholders, execute across client industries, and engage in marketplace activities.
  
  
**What will this person do?**

* Monitor Managed Review India projects to establish priorities and ensure all client objectives are met.
* Ensure effective collaboration with Lighthouse US and EMEA Managed Review, Client Services, and other Lighthouse delivery teams.
* Assist in ongoing assessment of revenue and service level metrics.
* Drive best practices within Lighthouse Managed Review
* Working with Lighthouse Managed Review leadership, create an organizational strategy for successful implementation of enterprise-level work.

* Provide vision, leadership, direction, and coaching to ensure continuous and successful employee development.
* Drive continual identification, development and implementation of delivery improvements focused on technology, people, and process.
* Manage the Lighthouse Managed Review India department, including 1:1s, performance reviews, reporting, administration, training, and mentorship, and providing continuous feedback.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Bring your passion and together we will shine. It would also be great if you had the following:**

* Eight+ years of experience leading a large-scale managed document review delivery team.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in law
* Eight+ years of experience providing sales support or overseeing managed review client relationships (experience coordinating and leading client onsite meetings preferred)
* Experience overseeing delivery of managed review for complex financial services and pharmaceutical clients strongly preferred.
* Excellent eDiscovery subject-matter communication and exceptional customer service demeanor
* Experience with monitoring and analyzing productivity, utilization and financial metrics preferred.
* Ability to work effectively internally and with clients.
* Excellent organizational, planning, prioritization, and problem-solving skills
* Mindset to positively contribute to meeting financial targets and other Managed Revie KPIs
* Ability to multitask, prioritize and organize under pressure.
* Working knowledge of eDiscovery technology, including Relativity and other Lighthouse Review technologies

**Work Environment and Physical Demands**

* Duties are performed in a typical office environment while at a desk or computer table.
* Duties require the ability to use a computer, communicate over the telephone, and read printed material, in a quiet and professional setting.
* Duties may require being on call periodically and working outside normal working hours (evenings and weekends).

Lighthouse celebrates and thrives on diversity and is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We hire, train, and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law. We welcome any talents and contributions you can bring to the team and are deeply committed to growing an environment where everyone can feel safe, is respected, and can show up as themselves. Come as you are!
  
  
As required by applicable pay transparency laws, Lighthouse complies with compensation disclosure requirements for roles that may be hired in locations under these requirements. This role will be eligible to participate in an annual bonus or incentive program.
  
  
As a trailblazer and catalyst for change, Lighthouse rises to each opportunity to help our clients, and our people do what they do best—shine.

title: Manager - Manufacturing Engineering
description:

Our purpose is design for the good of humankind. It’s the ideal we strive toward each day in everything we do. ***Manager - Manufacturing Engineering***
***Report to Production Manager***
***Location: MillerKnoll Bidadi Factory***
*General Purpose*
*The Manager - Manufacturing Engineering is responsible for leading manufacturing engineering activities to support new product introductions, localization projects, process optimization, automation, cost reduction, and operational excellence initiatives.*
**Essential Functions**

* Lead manufacturing engineering activities for new product introductions (NPI) and ensure manufacturing readiness for successful product launches.
* Drive localization initiatives and support development and implementation of locally sourced components and materials.
* Lead automation and digitization projects to improve productivity, reduce labor dependency, and enhance operational efficiency.
* Develop, implement, and sustain standardized manufacturing processes, work instructions, and best practices.
* Identify and execute cost reduction opportunities through process improvements, waste elimination, and value engineering.
* Manage capital expenditure projects including machinery, tooling, fixtures, conveyors, storage systems, and production equipment.
* Lead continuous improvement and Lean Manufacturing initiatives using Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, PDCA, and other operational excellence tools.
* Collaborate with Product Development, Supply Chain, Quality, Operations, and Procurement teams to achieve business objectives.
* Drive root cause analysis and corrective actions for production, quality, and process-related issues.
* Establish and monitor manufacturing KPIs related to safety, quality, productivity, delivery, and cost.
* Support quality improvement initiatives to reduce defects, improve process capability, and ensure customer satisfaction.
* Develop and mentor manufacturing engineers, facilitators, and technical teams through coaching and capability-building programs.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, safety requirements, environmental standards, and regulatory guidelines.

*Exposer to Lean tools like OEE, 5S, problem solving, FMEA process, line balancing, line design- basic knowledge, cycle time reduction, Ergonomic studies and basics of BOM structure.*

*Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, Industrial, Manufacturing or related Engineering discipline. 8-10 years of manufacturing engineering experience with 2-3 years in a leadership role.*

*Strategic Thinking, Customer Focus, Building Effective Teams, Driving Results, Innovation, Change Management and Collaboration.*

Simply put, we hire qualified applicants representing a wide range of backgrounds and abilities. MillerKnoll is comprised of people of all abilities, gender identities and expressions, ages, ethnicities, sexual orientations, veterans from every branch of military service, and more. Here, you can bring your whole self to work. We’re committed to equal opportunity employment, including veterans and people with disabilities.
  
  
MillerKnoll complies with applicable disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact MillerKnoll Talent Acquisition at careers\_help@millerknoll.com.

title: General Manager Manufacturing
description: General Manager — Manufacturing Head of Factory Operations — all units Department Manufacturing / Factory Operations Reports To CEO / COO Supervises Plant Heads and functional leaders — Production, Quality, Maintenance, Stores, Planning & Dispatch — across all units Scope All manufacturing units (currently 4–5 factories) + the upcoming Industry 4.0 automated plant Location Based at the anchor factory (Malur), with regular travel to every unit ROLE SUMMARY Lead all of Decorpot's manufacturing as the single accountable head of factory operations. Anchored at one plant and travelling regularly to the others, standardise operations, quality, cost, safety and delivery across every unit — and lead the design, build and ramp-up of the upcoming Industry 4.0 automated facility. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES • Own manufacturing end-to-end: single point of accountability for output, quality, cost, delivery and safety across all factories. • Standardise across units: drive one common set of processes, SOPs and KPIs — production, quality, maintenance, stores, dispatch — so every plant runs to the same standard. • Drive throughput, OEE & quality: own capacity utilisation, machine uptime, on-time production and defect / site-snag reduction; build a zero-defect culture and eliminate bottlenecks. • Lead a large workforce: direct and contract labour across plants — productivity, shift systems, skilling, industrial and employee relations, and discipline. • Cost, safety & compliance: drive material yield, wastage, conversion cost and energy efficiency; enforce EHS and full statutory compliance (Factories Act, pollution, labour) across every site. • Lead the Industry 4.0 agenda: conceive, design, commission and ramp the new automated plant — MES, IoT, robotics / automation, and data-driven shop-floor operations. • Capacity, CAPEX & bench: plan capacity and commission machinery / new lines; own the manufacturing CAPEX case; hire, mentor and build succession depth among plant heads. • Cross-functional & governance: align manufacturing with sales demand, design, SCM / dispatch and procurement; run site reviews and publish MIS to leadership. title: Quality Manager
description:
**Job Description – Quality Manager**

Ingenious Engineering Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced and results-driven \*\*Quality Manager\*\* to lead quality assurance and quality control operations across its steel fabrication and OEM manufacturing processes. The role involves establishing and implementing quality standards, managing inspection teams, ensuring compliance with customer specifications, and driving continuous improvement to deliver high-quality fabricated steel components and assemblies.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage all quality assurance and quality control activities across incoming materials, in-process manufacturing, and final product inspection.
* Develop, implement, and monitor quality procedures, inspection plans, and control processes to ensure compliance with customer specifications and applicable industry standards.
* Supervise, train, and guide the quality inspection team to maintain consistent inspection practices and performance.
* Review and interpret \*\*mechanical drawings, technical specifications, tolerances, and quality requirements\*\* to ensure product conformity.
* Oversee dimensional inspections, weld quality inspections, material verification, and final acceptance of fabricated components and assemblies.
* Ensure proper maintenance of inspection reports, test certificates, material traceability records, non-conformance reports, and quality documentation.
* Investigate quality issues, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to prevent recurrence.
* Coordinate with design, production, planning, procurement, and dispatch teams to resolve quality concerns and ensure timely delivery of conforming products.
* Manage customer quality complaints, coordinate inspections and audits, and ensure timely closure of corrective actions.
* Establish and monitor quality performance indicators, identify recurring defects, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure proper calibration, maintenance, and utilization of inspection instruments and measuring equipment.
* ·Support internal and external audits and ensure adherence to applicable quality management systems and customer requirements.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
* 8 - 12 years of relevant experience in quality assurance and quality control, preferably in steel fabrication, OEM manufacturing, or the engineering industry.
* Proven experience in managing quality operations and leading an inspection or quality control team.
* Strong understanding of \*\*fabrication processes, welding inspection, dimensional inspection, material specifications, and mechanical drawings\*\*.
* Hands-on experience with inspection instruments, measurement techniques, inspection plans, and quality documentation.
* Knowledge of root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Familiarity with ISO 9001 quality management systems and relevant industry standards.
* Excellent leadership, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to coordinate effectively across departments and manage multiple quality requirements.
* A proactive, detail-oriented, and results-driven approach, with a strong commitment to product quality and customer satisfaction.

title: Outlet Manager

**Company Description**
Join a hotel that is a member of the Accor network, whose group brings together more than 45 brands, 5,500 hotels, 10,000 restaurants and lifestyle destinations. * Handle guests’ complaints and comments tactfully and efficiently
* Handle all administration work pertaining to cashier/bar operation requirement and company’s policies

* Check the supply of equipment/stock level and ensure that there is no shortage of items which have impact on the operation and guests

* Attend all briefings, meetings and trainings as assigned by management
* Perform proper handover and communication to the next shift
* Assist other food & beverage outlets with their operations during peak times or when required

**Qualifications**

* Hotel Management graduate or equivalent
* Additional certification(s) in Food & Beverage will be an advantage
* Good reading, writing and oral proficiency in English language
* Ability to speak other languages and basic understanding of local languages will be an advantage
* Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in a similar capacity
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel, Word, & PowerPoint
* High degree of professionalism with sound human resources management and business acumen capabilities

Additional Information
  
  

* Strong knowledge of hotel reservation systems (PMS), Central Reservation Systems (CRS), channel management, and online travel agency (OTA) platforms.
* Good understanding of revenue management principles, room inventory control, yield management, upselling, and forecasting.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, leadership, and team management skills.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, and hotel reservation reporting tools.
* Ability to handle guest inquiries, special requests, and escalated concerns professionally while maintaining high service standards.
* Excellent command of written and spoken English; knowledge of additional languages will be an advantage.
* Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering exceptional guest experiences and achieving departmental revenue targets.

Inventory & Material Management

**Required Qualifications**
